videos.desc: A steady shot taken from the very brink of an enormous waterfall on a bright day. A broad sheet of deep green water slides towards the camera and pours over a long curved edge that stretches far away across the frame. White foam breaks along the top, and a huge white cloud of spray rises from below and fills the right-hand half of the picture. Blue sky and small clouds sit above the far shore.

A first-person shot on a narrow concrete pier over bright turquoise sea. The person walks up to a round shaft in the concrete and looks straight down into it: a dark green mossy hole going far down out of sight. They lower themselves in and drop down the shaft, the walls rushing past, the round opening of daylight shrinking above their black trainers. At the bottom the shaft opens under water and they come out over pale sand with orange coral patches on the seabed, still looking down at their own feet.

A drone films a tall bridge built of stone blocks, its arches and piers rising out of a green jungle gorge, with an enormous waterfall pouring down the cliff directly behind it. A freight train with a blue locomotive and dark red wagons rolls slowly across the top of the stonework. The camera pulls back to show the full height of the falls, the water breaking into white threads over the rock while the train crosses in front of them.

A drone looks down on a huge flat field of bright green rice. In the middle of it sits a round stone well full of dark water, with a narrow footpath leading to it through the crop. A line of boys in red shorts stands along the well's stone rim; one after another they jump in, each landing with a white burst of spray. The last shot is straight down from above: five of them float on their backs in the round pool of water in a star shape, the green field all around.

A young man in a red checked jacket films himself on a Canadian trip. He first paddles a red canoe across a glassy turquoise lake ringed by snowy peaks. He then stands on a viewing platform in a blue plastic poncho with an enormous waterfall thundering right behind him, the whole curve of it churning white and throwing spray and mist over him while he laughs. Finally he walks through a forest of blazing red and orange maples and holds a single red leaf up to the camera.

A wide concrete dam wall sits across a green valley in the rain. Brown floodwater fills the reservoir behind it right up to the lip and pours over the top in two huge falls, crashing into the gorge below and throwing up white spray and mist. A small building and a road run along the crest of the dam.
videos.said: Wow, look how the dam starts to overflow.

videos.desc: A follow-cam view behind a skateboarder in a helmet and gloves riding down an empty coastal road at sunset. The road curves along the side of a dry hillside, and on the right the land drops away to the sea, which runs out to a golden horizon. The rider crouches, puts a hand out through the bends and keeps rolling down towards the water.

Filmed from behind a rope barrier at the foot of a grassy ridge. First one armoured fighter with a red banner appears on the crest, then a long line of re-enactors with coloured flags comes over the top and charges down the slope toward the camera, passing a white canvas tent. Spectators in the foreground film it on their phones.

A woman in a striped headscarf rides a train and looks out of the window at a river and dry hills sliding past. She then rides in a crowded minibus with bundles of luggage strapped overhead. Finally she hikes up a stony mountain path with a canvas backpack and a walking stick and stops on the ridge, where the whole valley opens out below her: a blue-painted village spread over the slope and bare brown mountains running to the horizon.

A young woman in a navy polo shirt sits in a coastal watch station with nautical charts pinned to the wall and a brass bell beside the window. She scans the water through binoculars. Through the glass the sea curves inland between two green headlands, sheltered water dotted with moored yachts, small boats and orange buoys, with the open sea beyond. An orange rescue boat powers out across the water leaving a long white wake, and she lowers the binoculars and points at it.

A woman in a pink jacket and a woollen bobble hat stands on a flooded salt flat so still that it works like a mirror: her whole body, the snow-capped volcano and every cloud appear again upside down in the water below her. She crouches down, touches the surface with one fingertip so rings spread out, then stands up and walks away, small against the doubled sky.

A red-haired woman in a yellow raincoat travels through three places. She cycles along an Amsterdam canal past gabled houses and rows of parked bicycles, then rides an electric scooter down a palm-lined seaside boardwalk under a blue sky, and finally sits on a camel plodding over bare orange sand dunes at sunset, a line of other camels behind her in the empty desert.

Two children sit on a wooden jetty at a turquoise mountain lake. A man picks up a large grey stone lying on the boards, carries it to the edge with both hands and hurls it into the water, throwing up a huge white splash. He then jumps in himself and surfaces in the lake.

Under a dark storm sky, a wide, completely level grassland stretches to a straight horizon. A herd of horses in brown, white and black gallops from left to right through a shallow pool of rainwater, splashing, and their reflections move across the water. Black and white birds fly up in front of them. A wooden fence post stands by a dirt track, and grey curtains of rain fall from the clouds in the distance.

In a street of red-brick houses flooded with brown water, a laughing young woman with a long braid and a green jacket in a wooden canoe reaches up and passes a paper bag of bread to a woman leaning out of an upper-floor window. She then sits down, picks up a paddle and paddles the canoe along the street. A shaggy grey dog stands in the canoe with her. A football and a blue crate of apples float nearby, two neighbours lean out of another upper window, and sandbags lie by a door.

On a grey beach covered in black oil, a young woman in a white protective suit, face mask and yellow rubber gloves kneels in the oily water and holds a seabird soaked in thick dripping oil, looking at it sadly. She then gets up with the bird in her hands and turns away to carry it off. Oil coats the sand, the rocks, the seaweed and crabs beside her. Behind her, workers in suits and boots carry crates, a yellow floating barrier lies along the waterline and a tanker ship sits on the grey sea.

In a dusty desert canyon with striped red and cream cliffs, a young woman with a long braid, a bandana on her head and another around her neck, a khaki vest and work gloves leans over a huge fallen log of petrified wood and presses her hands on a broken piece of it. The stone shines inside in deep red, yellow and purple. The wind blows dust, and a hat flies through the air. Her colleagues shield their eyes and watch, and a tripod and a pickup truck stand behind.

A sunny alpine valley. A marmot stands upright on a big lichen-covered rock in a meadow full of small purple, yellow and white wildflowers, then jumps down and runs off. A clear stream runs past a wooden fence and a small stone hut, dark pine woods cover the slopes, and a waterfall appears on the mountainside. Behind them rises a sharp, pointed mountain peak whose top is covered in white snow, with a plume of cloud blowing off the summit into the deep blue sky.

A young woman climbs a steep snowy mountain slope under grey and white clouds with patches of blue sky. She wears a red down jacket, black trousers, a woollen hat, goggles, a climbing harness and crampons. With an ice axe in each hand she drives one axe into the snow, swings the other high above her head and pulls herself up step by step, close to the camera. A rope runs down the slope behind her, dark rocks stick out of the snow, and small orange tents stand further down the ridge.

An old blue wooden rowing boat on a lake at sunset, with pine forests and hills behind. Water lies in the bottom of the boat around a coil of rope. A woman in a mustard jumper and jeans, seen only by her arms and knees, dips a tiny teaspoon into the water in the boat and tips it over the side, one spoonful at a time. Facing her, a young man in a white shirt holds the oars, laughs so hard he wipes his eyes, and a brown and white spaniel sits behind him.
